note: CC0 PBR textures from ambientCG (https://ambientcg.com, CC0 1.0). Downloaded by tools/fetch_textures.py into game/assets/textures/ (not committed). The game falls back to flat colours when a set is missing. A set is an asset id at the default resolution or {asset, resolution}. The photo_* sets are the realistic ground of the panelka texture style (config/visuals/texture_styles.json).

photo_lawn.use: urban lawn with clover and weeds

photo_meadow.use: dense dark grass: parks, woods, lusher patches

photo_verge.use: mossy patchy grass of verges and unkempt fill ground

photo_trodden.use: trodden bare soil of yards and desire paths
